subject: Lucid Lane renewal & capacity — bakeoff request and term discussion
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morales <evan@lucidlane.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Lucid Lane renewal & capacity — bakeoff request and term discussion

Hi Evan,

Happy Friday — your account is coming up for renewal in Q3 and I wanted to open the conversation early so we can avoid any last-minute capacity crunches. Based on your usage over the last 12 months you’re right on the cusp of the next committed tier; we can lock in monthly capacity at a 10% lower unit rate if you move to a 12‑month reserved plan.

I know you mentioned wanting to expand the recommendations feature and add a second inference cluster for DR — happy to include that in the renewal quote. If there’s appetite for a quick bake-off against any third-party providers, we can run a targeted benchmark (we’ll provide the test matrix and a sandbox) and front-load results to help with procurement.

Proposed next steps:
- Would you be open to a 2-week benchmark window in late June?
- I’ll pull in Aditya (SE) to define the test matrix and Marissa (AM) to scope the term sheet.

If you prefer to skip the bake-off, I can send an updated term sheet with the reserved-capacity pricing and a capacity guarantee.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

[Attachment: lucidlane-renewal-outline-1p.pdf]

From: Evan Morales <evan@lucidlane.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lucid Lane renewal & capacity — bakeoff request and term discussion

Soojin,

Appreciate the heads up. We have an internal push to evaluate alternatives — AltServe reached out and our CTO wants a quick bake-off focused on latency at 2k token windows and cost under sustained traffic. Procurement also asked us to get competitive pricing in writing.

We are definitely interested in expanding recommendations (will need an extra 50 concurrent streams during peak). Yes to a 2-week window — kickoff next Monday works. Can you confirm:
- Will Redwood provide warm KV cache snapshots for a fair apples-to-apples run?
- Are you willing to commit to a temporary capacity reservation during the window so our tests aren’t subject to noisy neighbors?

Looping in procurement: procurement@lucidlane.com — they’ll want a quote and a PO timeline.

—Evan
Evan Morales | VP Product, Lucid Lane
evan@lucidlane.com

Team,

Evan just confirmed AltServe is in play and they want a 2-week bake-off starting Monday. Can Aditya and Marissa please own the operational plan and the save offer? Key asks from the client: KV cache snapshots for parity, a temporary capacity reservation for the test window, and results focused on 2k-token latency and cost under sustained load.

Aditya — can you draft a test matrix and a minimal infra spec (GPUs, concurrency, datasets)? Attach a sample results doc so procurement can see proof points.
Marissa — I’ll need a term sheet with: 12‑month reserved capacity price, a one-time onboarding credit, and an explicit capacity SLA during the bake-off. Also prep a short executive summary for Evan’s CTO.

Dylan — if we need to escalate capacity to Dedicated for a short window, what’s the minimum lead time?

Thanks — this is high priority.
Soojin

Date: 2028-06-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lucid Lane renewal & bakeoff request — test matrix attached

Soojin / Marissa / Dylan,

Attached sketch: lucidlane-benchmark-matrix.csv — includes:
- Workloads: recommendations inference (2k token), rerank (500 token), batch embeddings
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost-per-1M-tokens (simulated), memory footprint
- Parity details: we will seed with a KV cache snapshot (sanitized) and run identical prompt sets across Redwood and AltServe.

Infra proposal (short):
- 2 x A100s (or equivalent) per node for the throughput profile they want
- Dedicated test queue with prefetched KV store and warmed caches
- Concurrency target: 50 concurrent streams (matches their ask)
- Warmup window: 4 hours of ramp before measurement

I’ll run a dry run Friday in the sandbox and attach a sample results PDF. For the capacity reservation: Dylan, please confirm whether we can pin Dedicated nodes for a 14-day window and any cost implications.

Attachments: lucidlane-benchmark-matrix.csv, test-results-sample.pdf (draft)

—Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — that matrix looks good. A couple of clarifications from procurement:
- We need a written quote for both: (a) 2-week dedicated test reservation and (b) the preferred 12-month reserved plan (unit rates + onboarding credit).
- If Redwood can provide an incubation credit covering the bake-off compute, procurement will prioritize Redwood for the shortlist.

Timeline constraint: we need signed PO terms by 2028-06-14 to hit an internal launch milestone. AltServe has offered a short pilot discount and is willing to run their own cache parity tests.

Procurement — attaching the test matrix so you have context.

—Evan

(On Jun 5, 2028, Aditya Rao wrote: attached matrix)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Morales <evan@lucidlane.com>, procurement@lucidlane.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-08T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lucid Lane renewal & capacity — final save offer and next steps

Evan / procurement team,

Thanks for the quick sync and for flagging the PO timeline. To keep Lucid Lane on the shortlist and minimize friction during the bake-off, Redwood can offer the following save package:

1) Bake-off support and credits
- Two weeks of pinned Dedicated capacity during the test window (14 days).
- We will provide a sanitized KV cache snapshot and the seeded prompts.
- Redwood will apply a $12,000 incubation credit to cover the majority of the bake-off compute.

2) Renewal & expansion term (12 months)
- Discounted reserved rate: 12% off list for the committed baseline (applies when signed by 2028-06-14).
- Capacity guarantee: 50 concurrent streams with SLA-backed best-effort scaling to 70 streams for 48 hours post-launch.
- One-time onboarding credit of $8,000 applied at contract execution.

3) Operational commitments
- Fast path support during the bake-off with a 1-hour response SLO for critical incidents.
- Post-test report within 48 hours with p50/p95/p99 and cost projections (we’ll attach the full results PDF).

If that package looks good, I’ll send the updated term sheet (lucidlane-term-sheet-v2.pdf) and a DocuSign for signatures. Given your PO cutoff, we can also provision the test nodes as soon as procurement confirms the intent to proceed.

Next steps:
- Evan: confirm acceptance of the incubation credit + pinned capacity by EOD 2028-06-09.
- Procurement: if acceptable, please share billing contact and PO number placeholder so we can reserve capacity.

Appreciate the urgency — we want to make this as low friction as possible for Lucid Lane.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
